description: This file defines an interface IObservableGrain for testing purposes, which includes methods for streaming values, handling errors, and retrieving call information, specifically within the context of Orleans grains.

classes.name: IObservableGrain
classes.description: An interface representing a grain that provides asynchronous enumerable data streams and control methods for testing.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Signals completion of the grain's operation.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Signals failure or error condition in the grain.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Pushes the next data item into the stream.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves an asynchronous stream of string values.

methods.name: GetValuesWithError
methods.description: Retrieves an asynchronous stream of integers with an embedded error at a specified index.

methods.name: GetIncomingCalls
methods.description: Returns a list of incoming method calls with interface and method names.
